title: Mahesh Babu's Varanasi is more than just time travel! SS Rajamouli reveals what drives the globetrotting adventure
excerpt: SS Rajamouli reveals how love, father-son emotions, time travel and mythology shape Varanasi, starring Mahesh Babu, Priyanka Chopra and Prithviraj Sukumaran.
content:
SS Rajamouli’s next big-screen venture, Varanasi, promises more than a journey across different eras and locations. The filmmaker has revealed that the Mahesh Babu-starrer draws its strength from human emotions, particularly the bond between a father and son and the love between a man and a woman.

Related Story: SS Rajamouli’s Varanasi vs RRR: Mahesh Babu’s next is 5-6 times bigger than Ram Charan-Jr NTR’s blockbuster in every aspect!

Rajamouli recently attended the 50th São Paulo International Film Festival in Brazil. He received the Leon Cakoff Career Award, while his blockbuster RRR was screened with Portuguese subtitles. The filmmaker also presented a glimpse of Varanasi, offering audiences a taste of his upcoming cinematic spectacle.

Why Rajamouli Is Keeping the Story Under Wraps?

Speaking to the ALMANAQUE21 YouTube channel during the festival, Rajamouli explained why he has chosen not to disclose the film’s storyline in detail.

“Sometimes I don’t, because the words don’t do justice to the scope of the film. That’s the reason why I released a glimpse of what Varanasi is to be. Instead of putting any words to it, we made a video which we released last year. It takes the audience through the worlds of Varanasi, what they’re going to experience, without telling them anything,” he said.

He encouraged viewers to watch the glimpse to understand the film’s scale. According to Rajamouli, the narrative moves across continents, time zones and mythological worlds.

“It is an adventure which travels through different worlds. It travels through Antarctica, through Africa, through the city of Varanasi, in different time zones. It travels into the time of mythology, where you see giants, Gods, and all that stuff. But everything is driven by the emotion of a father and son, and the emotion of a man and a woman…the love between them. That drives this entire adventure scheme,” said the filmmaker.

Mahesh Babu, Priyanka Chopra and Prithviraj Lead the Cast

Directed by Rajamouli, Varanasi is co-written by his father, V Vijayendra Prasad, and cousin, SS Kanchi. Backed by Sri Durga Arts and Showing Business, the film features Mahesh Babu as Rudhra, Priyanka Chopra as Mandakini and Prithviraj Sukumaran as antagonist Kumbha.

The project marks Rajamouli’s first directorial outing since RRR, which starred Jr NTR and Ram Charan. The glimpse also sparked speculation and excitement over Mahesh Babu’s reported portrayal of Lord Rama.

A Ramayana Connection Before His Mahabharata Dream

Meanwhile, in a recent appearance on the Empire Film Podcast, Rajamouli expressed dissatisfaction with existing adaptations of Indian epics, including the Ramayana and the Mahabharata. Although his long-cherished Mahabharata project may take time, Varanasi will include a sequence inspired by the Ramayana, featuring the battle between Rama and Kumbhakarna.

The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres on April 7, 2027, coinciding with Ugadi. With mythology, adventure and relationships at its centre, Varanasi is shaping up to be an ambitious addition to SS Rajamouli’s filmography.
